parameter.name: username
parameter.label: Username
parameter.description: The email address of the MobileLink account

parameter.name: mfaCode
parameter.label: MFA Code
parameter.description: One-time code for accounts with multi-factor authentication. Only needed when the bridge status asks for it: enter the current code from the authenticator app, or the code sent by SMS or email, and save.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Specifies the refresh interval in seconds
